dossier.title: Navigation resilience programme: Earth, Moon and Mars
dossier.banner: MODELLED RESULTS - every number in this dossier is simulation output of the open Kshana engine, labelled VALIDATED, MODELLED or PARTNER as the engine labels it. This is an engineering study, not a certification and not acceptance by any authority.

matrix.text: With 240 low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites added, precise point positioning (PPP) shall converge within 10 minutes (median over the seeded runs).
With GPS and Galileo alone, precise point positioning (PPP) shall converge within 10 minutes (median over the seeded runs).
With the LEO layer the fused three-dimensional position error shall be 0.5 m root mean square (RMS) or better.
The lunar relay constellation shall give a position fix with a position dilution of precision (PDOP) of 6 or better over at least 95 % of the lunar surface and of the day.
Where the lunar relay constellation gives a fix, the median position dilution of precision (PDOP) shall be 6 or better.
Under the scripted L-band interference, the GPS L5 carrier-to-noise density ratio (C/N0) shall stay at or above 25 dB-Hz.
Under the scripted L-band interference, the GPS L1 coarse/acquisition (C/A) carrier-to-noise density ratio (C/N0) shall stay at or above 25 dB-Hz.
In the chained jamming, spoofing and holdover mission the clock time error shall stay within its 50 ns guard at every timeline step.
matrix.detail: `timeline.channels.time_error_ns.values <= timeline.channels.guard_ns.values` for all: 275 of 458 elements satisfy (first failing); element 214: 51.782497 ns <= 50 ns

matrix.text: In the chained mission a spoofing alarm shall be raised within 30 minutes of the start.
Around Mars the constellation-only position error shall be 5 m root mean square (RMS) or better over one sol.
Around Mars the constellation shall give a position fix at 99 % of epochs or more.
The receiver housing shall carry the programme's identification label.

Charts are drawn only for the paths the programme names. The chart the engine drew for each run is kept beside its result.
A scenario is run from its own text. A data file a scenario names by relative path is not copied into the dossier.
The PDF is identical between two builds except for the trailer identifier, which the PDF library fills with random characters.

The dossier hash, the manifest and the ledger are not signed: they show that the files agree with each other, not who issued them. Pass the dossier hash to the recipient by a separate route when origin matters.
Nothing in this dossier is a certification, a qualification or an acceptance by any authority.

coexist.title: Generic low Earth orbit signal plans against the open satellite navigation signals (illustrative Walker shells)
coexist.label: MODELLED: aggregate radio-frequency compatibility of candidate signal plans with open-service global navigation satellite system (GNSS) signals. The spectral separation coefficients and single-satellite losses underneath are read from the open engine's leo-signal kind, which computes them from its VALIDATED closed forms (Betz 2001 spectral separation, band-limited power spectral densities); the engine labels those compatibility figures MODELLED. The aggregation over the satellites in view is a MODELLED upper bound (every visible satellite at the maximum received power). Not a coordination filing and not a regulatory finding.
coexist.bound: An upper bound, not a prediction: in the direction the plan causes, every satellite in view at a cell is taken at the plan's maximum received power, with no elevation-dependent power and no receive-antenna pattern, and the count is the most satellites in view at that cell at any epoch. The mean case uses the mean number in view at the reference power. In the direction the plan receives, the open GNSS presets' satellites in view are each taken at the GNSS minimum received power the open engine states (the interface-specification minimum), so that direction is a most-in-view figure at minimum GNSS power, not a power bound.
coexist.limit_source: Illustrative limit for this example only; not a regulatory, coordination or protection criterion
